lines: [excited] Rocco! I got a mystery package!
[flat] I didn't order anything for you.
[puzzled] Me neither. Just socks. And a card with a QR code.
[explaining] Sellers mail stuff to real addresses so they can post fake reviews in your name.
[serious] And that QR code can send you to a site that steals your info. Don't scan it.
[pause, then hopeful] ...So. I'm keeping the socks.
[dry] Keep the socks. Toss the QR code.
